mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.book_id, r.author_id, r.status, r.remark, r.audit_admin_id, r.submit_time, r.audit_time, b.book_name AS book_name FROM book_audit_record r LEFT JOIN book_info b ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE r.status = #{status} ORDER BY r.submit_time DESC
